title: PSPHunter machine learning predicts key phase-separation residues
summary: PSPHunter predicts the residues most important for protein phase separation. In vivo and in vitro experiments showed that truncating six key residues of GATA3 disrupts phase separation, enhances tumor cell migration and inhibits growth. The analysis found glycine enrichment among key residues, and PSPHunter identifies nearly 80% of disease-associated phase-separating proteins.
